title: Tuples with more than 8 values are not properly serialized

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
We have a project with some ~2000 tests running xUnit 3.0.0. The update to 3.0.1 causes the test process to crash on Ubuntu ARM64:

```default
VSTest version 18.0.0-preview-25380-108 (arm64)

Starting test execution, please wait...
A total of 1 test files matched the specified pattern.
[xUnit.net 00:00:00.69]     [FATAL ERROR] System.Reflection.TargetParameterCountException
[xUnit.net 00:00:00.69] Catastrophic failure: System.Reflection.TargetParameterCountException : Parameter count mismatch.
[xUnit.net 00:00:00.68]     [FATAL ERROR] System.Reflection.TargetParameterCountException
[xUnit.net 00:00:00.68] Catastrophic failure: System.Reflection.TargetParameterCountException : Parameter count mismatch.
[xUnit.net 00:01:00.69]     [FATAL ERROR] Xunit.Sdk.TestPipelineException
[xUnit.net 00:01:00.69] Catastrophic failure: Test process crashed with exit code 1.
No test is available in /home/runner/work/CSnakes/CSnakes/src/CSnakes.Runtime.Tests/bin/Debug/net8.0/CSnakes.Runtime.Tests.dll. Make sure that test discoverer & executors are registered and platform & framework version settings are appropriate and try again.
[xUnit.net 00:01:00.67]     [FATAL ERROR] Xunit.Sdk.TestPipelineException
[xUnit.net 00:01:00.68] Catastrophic failure: Test process crashed with exit code 1.
No test is available in /home/runner/work/CSnakes/CSnakes/src/CSnakes.Runtime.Tests/bin/Debug/net9.0/CSnakes.Runtime.Tests.dll. Make sure that test discoverer & executors are registered and platform & framework version settings are appropriate and try again.
```

CI Run: https://github.com/tonybaloney/CSnakes/actions/runs/17285046193/job/49060692051?pr=648

Related: https://github.com/xunit/xunit/issues/3386

We found the crash was related to a test with `[MemberData(nameof(SubTestCases)]` and changing it to `[MemberData(nameof(SubTestCases), DisableDiscoveryEnumeration = true)]` fixed the issue

Change to enable tests: https://github.com/tonybaloney/CSnakes/pull/688
